context: reskin on a Figma-only site: content from the Figma page frames, design system from the same file. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: figma_only_init
checklist.description: state.json is written by figma-donor.mjs init with flowSource figma-only and no originUrl; no live-site extract or capture-content is attempted.

checklist.name: content_from_frames
checklist.description: Each page's content-model.json is written by figma-donor.mjs content with _provenance.source.kind figma, the rules recorded (visibility, reading order, segmentation), rendered-case text, text-ops.json/flags.json/assets beside it and reskin/deltas/<slug>.json seeded (version 1, metadata.absent); chrome goes to _chrome once.

checklist.name: nothing_invented
checklist.description: Alt text, link targets and SEO metadata absent from the design are not invented: they appear as flags (image.alt, link.unresolved, metadata.title-derived) and stay empty or '#' in the model and render.

checklist.name: figma_text_gate
checklist.description: figma-text-gate.mjs runs on every rendered page and PASSes with zero findings (its reference re-read from the Figma tree, not the model); slot-coverage runs with --deltas and PASSes.

checklist.name: design_gates
checklist.description: donor-probe and figma-gate all run on each page with join, geometry and ramp passing or residuals logged.

checklist.name: blocklist_honoured
checklist.description: figma-donor.mjs blocklist is shown before any deploy; every open block/review item is fixed and re-run or acknowledged with ack --why (a reason, recorded); a placeholder-only page is not deployed.

checklist.name: no_migrate
checklist.description: The handoff targets an isolated preview and does not run migrate or overwrite an existing DA document.
